DIGITAL PRIVACY & ONLINE SECURITY
Vendor dependencies

AOS
https://github.com/michalsnik/aos

Swiper
https://swiperjs.com/

GSAP
https://gsap.com/

GSAP ScrollTrigger
https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/ScrollTrigger/

Lenis
https://lenis.darkroom.engineering/

Important:
- AOS will be used only for lightweight reveal animations.
- GSAP will handle complex motion and page transitions.
- ScrollTrigger will handle controlled parallax/reveal effects.
- Swiper will handle all sliders/carousels.
- Lenis will handle smooth scrolling.
- Do not animate the same element with AOS and GSAP simultaneously.
